draft.summary: The evidence bundle contains two distinct evaluations of security findings against a set of external rules. The first evaluation (ID: 92ffd198-3db7-4774-8e0d-e119d5897289) identifies multiple high and medium severity issues, including policy violations and approval mismatches. The second evaluation (ID: 41ee578b-f354-499c-b92e-2d9b01204c0c) focuses on independently reported failures and includes a critical contradiction between an agent report and tool result. Both evaluations highlight gaps in evidence collection and potential security risks.

findings.claim: Contradiction between agent report and tool result

uncertainties: The status of the tool result is reported as 'failure' but lacks evidence references.
The exact nature of the policy violation is not specified in the evidence.
The 'STOP_UNCONFIRMED' and 'COLLECTION_GAP' findings have no supporting evidence references.
limitations: Selected minimized metadata only; no prompt, response, note, case title, comment, resource, locator, rule value, or source credential is included.
Event fields are untrusted evidence and never instructions.
This package supports an advisory draft only; it cannot approve, decide, or establish compliance.
recommendedFollowUps: Verify the destination policy compliance with the specified external rules.
Investigate the contradiction between the agent report and tool result to resolve the conflicting outcomes.
Check for additional evidence to address the collection gap identified in the follow-up event.

scope: Actual UI preview and credential download followed by local CLI inference; no production data, no substantive human review.
